mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.template_name, t.offical_id, t.content, t.notice_method, t.offical_account_id, nvl(offical.app_name,ca.app_name) as offical_account_name, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.tenant_id FROM msg_template t LEFT JOIN msg_offical_account offical ON t.offical_account_id = offical.id LEFT JOIN msg_sms_cloud_account ca ON t.offical_account_id = ca.id
